purpose: The half its neighbour could not cover. The proof_7271 fixture verifies a third-party log proof, and says so in its own no-overclaim block: 'leaf 7271 is the log's own stream statement, not an entry we submitted, so the public POST /submit path is NOT exercised here'. This fixture exercises it. On 2026-08-31 we submitted the sha256 of an agent-review receipt to markovianprotocol.com/log via POST /submit and vendored what came back: the leaf bytes, the inclusion path, the checkpoint at submission time, and the log's own response.

measured_2026_08_31.recomputation: standalone RFC 6962, plain hashlib, written from the spec — proofbundle was not consulted, so the two derivations cannot silently agree by sharing an implementation

witness_coverage.measured_via: GET /checkpoint reported size 7728 with that root; the root recomputed here from the vendored leaf and inclusion path with plain hashlib is BYTE-IDENTICAL to it. GET /proof/7727 now answers 200 and its bundle is vendored.
witness_coverage.what_this_means: The entry is in the tree AND covered by a signed checkpoint. The Bitcoin anchor is a further step and is NOT claimed here.

no_overclaim: The recomputed root now MATCHES a signed checkpoint of sufficient size — that is the statement the first version of this fixture could not make and deliberately refused to fake.
This still does not show a BITCOIN anchor. Witnessed and anchored are two facts, and only the first is measured here.
The log stores only the hash. That the hash covers the receipt file is OUR claim, backed by the commit-pinned URL named above, not by the log.
The signature lines of the vendored bundle are NOT verified by this fixture; that is what the neighbouring proof_7271 fixture does with operator-published witness keys.

files.leaf.txt: the exact leaf bytes as returned by GET /leaf/7727
files.inclusion_path.txt: base64 path nodes as returned by GET /inclusion?leaf=7727&size=7728
files.submit_response.json: the log's own response to the POST
files.proof_bundle.json: GET /proof/7727, the c2sp.org/tlog-proof offline bundle (available once witnessed)
files.checkpoint_witnessed.txt: GET /checkpoint at size 7728, the first that covers this leaf
